svg.title: One man, two stages: Trump offers UFC chief Dana White the press secretary job
svg.desc: Editorial illustration split by a diagonal. On the left, in an orange-and-black fight-night setting in London, Dana White, bald and in a dark suit with an open collar, speaks at a news-conference table crowded with microphones under stage lights, with boxing-ring ropes behind him and silhouetted reporters raising cameras and phones. On the right, the White House briefing-room podium stands empty under a single spotlight in front of a blue curtain and empty seats. A dashed jet contrail arcs from his side toward the podium. Represents President Trump saying on Nov. 7, 2026, that he offered White the vacant press secretary job, and White saying in London he would fly to Washington for a Monday meeting; the empty podium shows the offer is unanswered, and the jet is a symbol, not a reported flight path.
